faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Cantonment Board Deolali Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Cantonment Board Deolali Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Filter Attendant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Cantonment Board Deolali Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed application form on pages 2-3 of this PDF; also available on the Cantonment Board website) and send it to The Chief Executive Officer, Cantonment Board Deolali, Office of the Cantonment Board, Deolali, Cannaught Road, Deolali Cantonment-422 401, Nashik Mashrashtra, by by post, to reach by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs.23605 per month (fixed payment, contract basis).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 12th Pass or equivalent from recognized Board / University. B.Sc. Special in Chemistry.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Incomplete applications or those received after the due date will be rejected. Candidates must attach self-attested copies of documents.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written test and/or skill test, as decided by the competent authority. Selection strictly on merit, based on performance in the written test or skill test.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement on purely contract basis on fixed payment for the period of 11 months. Engagement is purely temporary and contractual and does not confer any right for continuation, regularization, or future employment.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Cantonment Board, Deolali.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Self-attested copies of educational qualifications (all education certificates); Proof of age; Experience certificates (if any); Nationality or Domicile Certificate; Self-attested recent passport size photograph affixed on the form.
